receipts.first_text_witness: You're standing in a Costco checkout line on a Tuesday afternoon and there are two guys ahead of you. Same age, 52, same khaki shorts. One of them just stepped out of a leased BMW X5 with a $1,140 monthly payment, a wrapped Apple Watch in his cart. The other one drove here in a 2016 Ford F-150 with 140,000 miles and a door dent he never bothered to fix. One of these men has 1.2 million dollars in index funds. Quick, which one? If you pick the BMW guy, you just made the same mistake as everyone else in that line because the F-150 guy is the millionaire and the BMW guy has $9,000 to his name and a payment due Friday.
receipts.last_text_witness: buy them without checking anything first. That's it. That's the whole prize. If you enjoyed this one, you'll probably like my video on every financial trap you'll face as your net worth grows. It's right up here. And let me know in the comments if you hit a million tomorrow, who's the first person you'd tell or would you tell no one? I read everything. Thanks for being here. Peace.
